content:
Today we are flying, Richard.
Are you sure it's safe, dad?
Of course, son. I fly all the time.
Can't we drive to grandma's house?
Yes, we can, but it takes longer.
Okay, dad. We'll fly.
You are going to love it, son.
I hope so.
